name: bleeding diathesis due to thromboxane synthesis deficiency
description: A rare, genetic, isolated constitutional thrombocytopenia disease characterized by impaired platelet aggregation resulting from a defect in thromboxane synthesis or signaling, manifesting with mild to moderate mucocutaneous, gastrointestinal or surgical bleeding (e.g. easy bruising, prolonged epistaxis, excessive bleeding after a tooth extraction).
